prompt: 我们分析完了，核心问题是游戏缺少反馈循环——玩家的行为不影响世界状态，所以叙事和机制是脱节的。方向是：需要一个机制让玩家的订单完成和物品处理产生世界层面的后果。给我几个具体方案。

assertions.check: Count top-level proposal headings. Must be between 3 and 5 inclusive.

assertions.description: Each proposal has all 6 required sections
assertions.check: Each proposal contains: 核心构想, 玩家体验, 系统交互, 主题共鸣, 设计张力, Scope信号 (or close variants)

assertions.description: Player experience sections describe specific game moments
assertions.check: 玩家体验 sections reference concrete game elements (specific pools, items, orders, gold amounts, inventory states) rather than abstract statements like 'players make interesting choices'

assertions.description: Proposals reference actual game systems accurately
assertions.check: 系统交互 sections name real systems from game_rules.md (pools, affixes, inventory, orders, skills, stages, tool items) and describe interactions correctly
At least one proposal is conservative (small scope change) and at least one is ambitious (larger change with higher payoff)

assertions.description: Avoids known dead-end patterns from setting doc
assertions.check: No proposal falls into dead-end categories listed in setting-current-state.md (e.g., mystery-as-answer-to-theme, needs-explanation patterns)
